scope: Controller integration inspection of disposable task2.1 staged code; not an independent gate

findings.finding: validateManifest requires every stage.change === direction.id; a multi-stage direction with distinct numbered OpenSpec changes cannot pass
findings.required: Versioned explicit owned stage-change mappings, safe unique IDs; positive two-stage fixture and foreign-change negative test

findings.finding: planClosure only returns descriptors; no actual temporary-Git sync/archive/reference relocation control exists, and generic declared spec paths can target frozen/product files
findings.required: Verify exact openspec/specs/<safe capability>/spec.md destinations against frozen scope; execute controlled disposable Git closure and verify bytes/origins/actual references, reject unsafe/foreign/stale/broken cases before writes

findings.finding: lifecycle test assumes cwd/evidence exists and creates file symlink to /etc/passwd
findings.required: Portable isolated temporary fixtures with actual Windows-compatible escape/junction coverage; no test.skip or missing-privilege PASS

findings.finding: Tests-only RED snapshot retained without original behaviorless production skeleton bytes
findings.required: Retain exact preimplementation skeleton files and test snapshot, so Windows replay fails behavioral assertions rather than import/setup; preserve original logs and all later repaired test diffs

findings.finding: STOP owner health exists but no deterministic repeated-defect/RCA guard is present
findings.required: Add tests-first structured two-failed-fix barrier with classified RCA/source authority; no raw JSON true approval

findings.finding: Malformed stage/scope arrays may throw or permit ambiguous references; requirement IDs hardcode FWE and path checks omit Windows-invalid characters
findings.required: Reject malformed inputs with stable issues; safe generic IDs and cross-platform path restrictions with meaningful boundary tests

findings.finding: Case-sensitive pathMatches/overlap permits a differently cased allowed/product path to avoid a frozen pattern on Windows
findings.required: Conservative canonical/case-aware containment and frozen checks; meaningful Apps/packages case and malformed scope regression cases

findings.finding: ARCHIVE -> CLOSED currently reuses POST barriers without an actual owner archive proof, so descriptors alone can label CLOSED
findings.required: Require verified owning archive operation with current origins/reference mapping and bound checkpoint/publication authority before CLOSED; reject merely completed tasks or declared archive PASS
